# Brainstorming Planner Agent

> A primary agent for OpenCode that facilitates structured brainstorming sessions using 6-3-5 Brainwriting and Rolestorming methodologies. Generates complete documentation of ideas, decisions, and rounds. Temperature 0.75 for creative output.

## Agent

- [brainstorm.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danifernandezs/brainstorming-agent/main/brainstorm.md): The agent configuration file. Copy this into ~/.config/opencode/agents/ (global) or .opencode/agents/ (per-project) to install.

## Documentation

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danifernandezs/brainstorming-agent/main/README.md): Full documentation — installation, usage, methodology details, session flow, and examples.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danifernandezs/brainstorming-agent/main/CHANGELOG.md): Version history and release notes.
